description: The source has an anomalous word before 'of the punishment'; translation marks the contextually probable sense 'cessation' as supplied.
Greek 'Manifestation and Truth' is retained as a title-like pair in the high-priestly cultic context.
The compact comparison 'like the filling of a threshing floor' has uncertain precise force; both versions preserve the agricultural image.
Source contains a Latin intrusion, compressed uncertain syntax, and a lacuna inside the identifiable Genesis 49:27 quotation; restoration is disclosed in the translation note.
